title: Connect to Desktop
subtitle: Your phone is the remote — the Nomifun desktop does the heavy lifting
scanHint: Enable phone access in Desktop Connections & Devices, then scan the phone pairing code
manualHint: Enter the full address shown by the desktop or relay, such as http://192.168.1.42:25808 or https://relay.example.com:19090
passwordHint: Find and configure the connection account and password in Desktop Connections & Devices → Other computer browsers
probeFailed: Cannot connect. For direct access check the LAN, Desktop listener and firewall. For remote access check relay availability, the address and HTTPS certificate. Keep Desktop running.
notNomifun: That address is not a Nomifun server
qrInvalid: Not a Nomifun connection QR code
qrExpired: QR code expired or already used — refresh it on the desktop and scan again
rateLimited: Too many attempts — wait 15 minutes and try again
setupHint: This is a fresh server — claim the admin account
cameraPermission: Camera permission is required to scan
pasteLinkHint: You can also paste the URL encoded in the QR code
disconnectConfirm: You'll need to scan or log in again to reconnect
webSameOrigin: Web build connects to the current site
scanPaused: Scanning paused. Follow the guidance, then scan again.
cameraSettingsHint: Camera access was denied. Allow Nomifun to use the camera in system settings.
cameraSettingsFailed: Unable to update camera access. Enable camera permission in system settings, then return.
devicePairRequired: Generate a phone pairing code in Desktop Connections & Devices. Browser login codes cannot register a phone.
updateRequired: The connection protocol or data identity is incompatible. Update Desktop and Mobile, then retry.
identityChanged: This address now points to a different Desktop. Check the address or pair again before sending saved credentials.
webOriginMismatch: This code belongs to another site. Open H5 from the target Desktop or relay phone entry. This web app connects only to its own site.
authRequired: Device authorization expired or was revoked. Generate a new phone pairing code on Desktop.
permissionDenied: This device is not allowed to perform the action. Check capability permissions on Desktop. Signing in again does not grant more access.
connectionChanged: The connection changed. The old request result was discarded; retry on the current connection.
httpsRequired: Remote connections require a full HTTPS address. HTTP is allowed only for localhost or trusted LAN connections.
devicesHint: Inspect your Desktop, network path and live status, repair the connection or manage this device's authorization.
accountCredentialHint: This connection has no device registration. Both QR pairing and account sign-in now register an independent device. Reconnect to enable individual revocation for this device.
accountFormHint: You can also enter the Desktop connection account and password. This registers an individual device that can be revoked from Desktop.
networkHelp: The Desktop must remain awake and running. Direct access needs the same LAN. Remote access needs an online relay and Desktop agent, with HTTPS / WSS at the entry.
voiceCapabilityHint: Voice also requires a provider configured for the selected Session and explicit microphone permission on the voice page. This check never activates the microphone.
routeIdentityHint: Before switching, the app verifies that the new address belongs to the same Desktop, then validates this device's authorization. Saved credentials are never sent to a different Desktop.
webDeploymentHint: H5, its API and WebSocket must share one HTTPS site. A separate static deployment needs a same-origin proxy configured by its operator. Mobile does not connect across sites automatically.
revokeHint: Revocation immediately invalidates this device's credentials and live connections. Other devices continue working. Pair again to reconnect.
forgetLocalHint: This removes only the phone's local credentials and works offline. Revoke server authorization from Desktop Connections & Devices.
pairHint: Confirm the target address before redeeming the one-shot code. The phone stores independent device authorization, not the original pairing code.
